agency: U.S. House Committee on Oversight and Accountability
title: Hearing: Unidentified Anomalous Phenomena - Implications on National Security, Public Safety, and Government Transparency (House Oversight, 26 Jul 2023)
doc_notes: This document is a transcript of a U.S. House Oversight Committee hearing on UAPs, containing multiple firsthand and secondhand accounts of close-range encounters.

encounters.summary: Two F-18 Super Hornets were split by a UAP described as a dark gray or black cube inside a clear sphere, which came within 50 feet of the lead aircraft.
encounters.entity_appearance: dark gray or black cube inside a clear sphere
encounters.location_name: Warning Area W-72, off the coast of Virginia Beach
encounters.quote: The object, described as a dark gray or a black cube inside of a clear sphere, came within 50 feet of the lead aircraft

encounters.summary: A white Tic Tac-shaped object was observed by multiple pilots, performing abrupt maneuvers and rapid acceleration, with no visible propulsion or control surfaces.
encounters.entity_appearance: white Tic Tac object, longitudinal axis, no rotors, no wings, no visible control surfaces
encounters.quote: saw a white Tic Tac object with a longitudinal axis pointing north south and moving very abruptly over the water like a ping pong ball

encounters.summary: Boeing contractors observed a 100-yard wide red square object hovering over a launch facility, which later approached security guards at high speed.
encounters.entity_behavior: hovering, darting off at rapid speeds
encounters.quote: observed a very large 100-yard sighted red square approach the base from the ocean and hover at low altitude

encounters.summary: Test pilots observed a diamond formation of four craft over the Gulf of Mexico; one pilot approached an orb-like craft which caused sensor malfunctions.
encounters.quote: saw a sequence of four craft in a clear diamond formation
